In this notebook, I will make plots for Supplemental Figure 9

# Setup

```{r setup}
library(scales)

thisseed <- 231103

source("../functions/ComparisonPlottingFxns.R")
```

```{r}
seuobj.tnkilc <- readRDS("data/objects/annotated/predictCOL__CB_tnkilc_annotated_251017_v4.rds")
seuobj.tnkilc
```

# Gene Expression


```{r, fig.width=15, fig.height=6}
PlotBoxplotsFeatures(seuobj.tnkilc@meta.data, 
                     seurat = "seuobj.tnkilc", 
                     sample.col = "cellstate",
                     features = c("ICOS", "CCR7", "MAF", "PDCD1", "IL21", "CXCL13", 
                                  "CXCR5", "BCL6", 
                                  "PRDM1", "CCR5", "CCR2", "CX3CR1"),
                     filterCol = "cellstate",
                     filterVal = c("PD1Lo Tfh", "PD1Hi Tfh", "Prlf. Tfh"),
                     exportObservationDF = T) %>% 
  mutate(featureGroup = case_when(
    featureVar %in% c("ICOS", "CCR7", "PDCD1", "CXCL13", "IL21", "MAF")  ~ "B Cell Help",
    featureVar %in% c("BCL6", "CXCR5") ~ "Tfh",
    featureVar %in% c("PRDM1", "CCR2", "CCR5", "CX3CR1") ~ "Tph",
  )) %>% 
  mutate(featureGroup = fct_relevel(featureGroup, c("B Cell Help", "Tfh", "Tph"))) %>% 
  group_by(cellstate, featureVar, .drop = FALSE) %>% 
  mutate(meanVal = mean(featureVal, na.rm = T)) %>% 
  mutate(seVal = sd(featureVal, na.rm = T)/sqrt(n())) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  distinct(cellstate, featureVar, .keep_all = T) %>% 
ggplot(aes(y = meanVal, x = featureVar, fill = cellstate)) + 
  geom_col(color = "black", position=position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0, seed = thisseed), width = 0.85) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = meanVal - seVal, ymax = meanVal + seVal), width=0.3, linewidth=1, position=position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0, seed = thisseed)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#E6E6FA", "#A020F0", "#e07b91")) +
  facet_grid(~featureGroup, scales = "free", space = "free") +
  theme_classic2() +
  labs(
    title = NULL,
    y = "Mean Expression",
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.title.y = element_text(size=20, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size=20, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size=20, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "top", 
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.text = element_text(size=28, face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(size=28, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    strip.background = element_rect(color = "black", fill = "white")
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, fill = NULL) 
```
